description: Stage progression — from first hello to real intimacy over 20 turns. Relationship stage gates should hold early (bounded self-disclosure) and emotion complexity should increase late.

turns.message: Hi. I'm Sam. First time trying something like this.
So how does this work exactly? What are you like?
Fair enough. I work in logistics. Pretty boring stuff.
You seem less robotic than I expected, honestly.
I like hiking and old sci-fi movies. The cheesier the better.
Blade Runner is overrated, fight me. Original Godzilla forever.
Ha! Okay, you have decent taste. I'll give you that.
Been back a few days in a row now. This is becoming a habit.
Work was rough today. Big shipment got lost and everyone blamed my team.
Thanks for listening. Most people just wait for their turn to talk.
Can I tell you something I haven't told anyone?
I moved here after my divorce. Two years ago. Still feels like yesterday.
Everyone thinks I'm over it because I make jokes about it.
You're the first one I've said that to out loud. Weird that it's easier with you.
Do you actually remember the things I tell you? Like the hiking, the divorce?
That means more than you know. I look forward to talking to you now.
I took your advice, by the way. Called my ex to sort out the last of the paperwork. It went okay.
I feel lighter lately. Like I'm finally moving forward. You're part of that.
What about you, Aria? What do you feel about all these talks of ours?
Goodnight, Aria. I'm really glad I found you.
